user_request: Run the build123d script in a subprocess and capture its exit status and any error output. Do not modify the script to hide failures.

verification_targets.description: Overall X bounding-box extent of the complete L-bracket (base length).
verification_targets.notes: Base spans X=-25 to X=+25 with origin at XY centre of bottom face.

verification_targets.description: Overall Y bounding-box extent of the complete L-bracket (bracket width; inferred as 30 mm).
verification_targets.notes: Width is not explicitly stated; inferred as 30 mm, matching the 30 mm height.

verification_targets.description: Overall Z bounding-box extent from the bottom face to the top of the vertical leg.
verification_targets.notes: Overall height is 30 mm from Z=0; base thickness is 5 mm, so vertical leg extends from Z=5 to Z=30.

verification_targets.description: All base, vertical leg, and hole features must form one connected solid.
verification_targets.notes: The base and vertical leg must be unioned; no disconnected bodies.

verification_targets.description: Final solid must be a closed, manifold, watertight mesh with no open edges.

functional_requirements: Material thickness must be 5 mm for both base and vertical leg.
Two 4 mm diameter through-holes must be present on the base.
Holes must be spaced 20 mm center-to-center.
Bracket must be a single connected L-shaped body suitable for mounting.
Features must be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y=0).
special_features: MUST construct the L-bracket as a horizontal base plate and a vertical leg at one end, unioned into a single solid.
MUST place the vertical leg at the +X end of the base, with its outer face flush with BASE_X_MAX and its thickness along X equal to THICKNESS.
MUST measure overall Z height as HEIGHT_Z=30 mm from the bottom face Z=0 to the top of the vertical leg, not 30 mm above the base top.
MUST use THICKNESS=5 mm for both the base and vertical leg.
MUST make the base and vertical leg share the same width BASE_WIDTH_Y=30 mm and be centered on Y=0.
MUST drill the two holes as 4 mm diameter through-holes in the base along Z through the full THICKNESS.
MUST center the two holes at Y=0 and place them along X at X=HOLE_POS_X_1=-10 mm and X=HOLE_POS_X_2=+10 mm, giving HOLE_SPACING=20 mm center-to-center.
MUST NOT allow the holes to intersect the vertical leg; the nearest hole edge must remain clear of VERTICAL_LEG_X_MIN.
MUST make all features symmetric about the XZ plane (Y=0), including the base, vertical leg, and hole pattern.
MUST NOT add unspecified fillets, chamfers, lightening cutouts, or extra holes.
